description: An annotated aerial or satellite image displays a coastal area highlighting a lagoon, classified as "8.3.1 Lagoons (without reeds)", enclosed by a thick yellow outline. The main water body of the lagoon is a blue-green colour, partially separated from the darker blue open sea on the right by a reddish-brown land spit. Inside the larger outlined area, there are several smaller, irregularly shaped land masses or islands, also delineated with a yellow outline. To the left of the main lagoon, the surrounding land features geometrically structured areas, including bright green rectangular plots and darker grey/reddish sections, consistent with agricultural fields, aquaculture, or salt evaporation ponds. The image provides a visual example for the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) CORINE Land Cover (CLC) nomenclature, specifically category 8.3.1, which pertains to coastal lagoons.
